sections.description:
Introducing the AI Alt Text Generator for WordPress – your ultimate solution for effortless Image Alt text Generator for image SEO. Our simple plugin is designed to revolutionize your alt text generation process with the help of AI.

With the AI Alt Text Generator, you can say goodbye to manual Image alt text entry. We’re automating alt text generation upon image upload, saving you time and effort. No matter how many images you have, our plugin can handle bulk alt text generation, making sure all your images are properly SEO optimized with perfect alt text, title and description.

You can choose from over 150 languages to generate alt text that resonates with your diverse audience. Plus, add your own touch with customizable prefixes or suffixes, enhancing your brand presence and SEO strategy.

Get started effortlessly by signing up and claiming your FREE API key. Try and start creating image alt text. Next, simply install the WordPress plugin, paste your API key, and you’re all set to utilize AI to generate alt text for all your image.

Test it out for FREE! No credit card necessary to begin your journey.

Features

  • Automated Alt Text Generation:
    Our plugin utilizes advanced AI technology to automatically generate high-quality image alt text for every image uploaded to your WordPress site. This ensures that your images are properly indexed by search engines, improving your site’s overall SEO performance.

  • Bulk Image Alt Text Generation:
    No matter how many images you have or how many libraries you have to manage, our plugin can efficiently generate image alt text in bulk, saving you time and effort. With just a few clicks, generate AI Alt Text for all your images at once and streamline your image SEO workflow.

  • Language Flexibility:
    With our language flexibility feature, you can reach a global audience. You can generate image alt text in over 150 languages to make your site more accessible and search engine friendly.

  • Automated Titles & Captions:
    You can boost your image SEO by adding AI-generated actual titles, captions, and descriptions. The plugin automatically generates these using AI, so every image contributes to your site’s SEO.

  • Prefix or Suffix Addition:
    Make your alt text stand out with customizable prefixes and suffixes. Make images more discoverable by incorporating brand keywords and additional descriptive phrases before the alt text or after the alt text.

  • Designed for WordPress:
    We call our plugin AI Image Alt Text generator for WordPress. Since it’s specifically designed for WordPress, you can ensure seamless integration and compatibility. It is easy to install and use, so you can concentrate on other things.

  • Streamlined Integration:
    Its integration process is seamless and does not require any additional coding. You can customize it to meet your specific needs. Furthermore, it is easy to install and use.

  • Affordable pricing:
    You can get affordable prices if you need to generate more and more images. The price is worth it because it saves you time by automatically generating ALT text for all your images so you don’t have to waste time doing small but important things.

  • Customization Options:
    Customize your alt text generation to perfection. Choose the language, add unique touches with prefixes or suffixes, and optimize your images with custom titles and captions to boost your site’s SEO performance.

sections.installation:
There is no prerequisites for installing Ai Image Alt Text Generator for WP. You can follow the steps below to complete the installation.

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New screen from your WordPress website dashboard.
  2. Search for Ai Image Alt Text Generator for WP.
  3. Install and activate the plugin, that’s it!
sections.faq:
Does the plugin come for free?

Yes, it’s completely free.

What is alt text, and why does it matter for SEO?

Alt text provides descriptions for images, crucial for SEO as it helps search engines understand image content, improves accessibility, and boosts search rankings.

How does the AI Alt Text Generator work?

Our plugin uses advanced AI to automatically generate descriptive alt text for images on your WordPress site when you upload, saving you time and effort.

Can the plugin handle bulk alt text generation?

Yes, it can. Our plugin efficiently generates alt text in bulk, making it easy to optimize all your images at once.

Is alt text generated in multiple languages?

Absolutely. Our plugin offers language flexibility, ensuring alt text is relevant for diverse audiences.

Can I customize the alt text?

Yes, you can. Our plugin allows customization with custom titles, captions, and keyword inclusion for improved SEO.

How do I get started?

Simply install the plugin and let it automatically generate alt text for your images. Try our free trial to experience the benefits firsthand.
